shortDescription: Allows to prune various podman objects

options.name: container_filters
options.description: A dictionary of filter values used for selecting containers to delete. For example, C(until: 24h). See L(the podman documentation, https://docs.podman.io/en/latest/markdown/podman-container-prune.1.html#filter-filters) for more information on possible filters.

options.name: image_filters
options.description: A dictionary of filter values used for selecting images to delete. You can also use C(dangling_only: false) to delete dangling and non-dangling images or C(external: true) to delete images even when they are used by external containers. See L(the podman documentation, https://docs.podman.io/en/latest/markdown/podman-image-prune.1.html#filter-filters) for more information on possible filters.

options.name: network_filters
options.description: A dictionary of filter values used for selecting networks to delete. See L(the podman documentation, https://docs.podman.io/en/latest/markdown/podman-network-prune.1.html#filter) for more information on possible filters.

options.name: system
options.description: Whether to prune unused pods, containers, image, networks and volume data

options.name: system_all
options.description: Whether to prune all unused images, not only dangling images.

options.name: system_volumes
options.description: Whether to prune volumes currently unused by any container.

options.name: volume_filters
options.description: A dictionary of filter values used for selecting volumes to delete. See L(the podman documentation, https://docs.podman.io/en/latest/markdown/podman-volume-prune.1.html#filter) for more information on possible filters.
